description: Land Title Settlement  Department   -  Amendment to  the Gaz. Ex. No. 2111/33 of 20.02.2019 Katana D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with the amendment of land title registration for a specific parcel of land (No. 78 of Block 10) in the Kadirana-North area. It involves corrections to the parcel number and extent measurements in the land registry, which falls under land and property-related matters. The document is published in "PART III - LANDS" and references the Registration of Title Act, further confirming its focus on land administration rather than government personnel or structural changes.
